title: Baseline systemic immune-inflammation index and a novel FLIPI-SII model predict POD24 and long-term survival in grade 1-3a follicular lymphoma.
caption: External multicenter validation of the FLIPI-SII model in 187 R-CHOP-treated patients with follicular lymphoma.  (A)  Overall survival.  (B)  Progression-free survival.
